## sweet-gantt (3479 lines, 34 files)
- **Build**: tsup
- **Dependencies**: clsx, date-fns, html-to-image, lucide-react, react, react-dom, react-i18next, sweet-types
- **Exports**: ProjectGantt, ProductGantt, BaseGantt, useGanttSettings, useGanttDragScroll, useGanttExport, useDragMilestone, useDragLivrable, useResizablePanel, ViewMode, TickGroup, DragMode, GanttSettings, BaseGanttContext

### Architecture
- **BaseGantt**: Shared shell with header, controls, grid, today line, export, resize panel. Uses render props.
- **ProjectGantt**: Phases as bars (draggable), milestones as triangles, livrables as sub-rows. PhaseBars, ProjectLeftPanel, ProjectLegendPopover, ProjectGanttTooltip.
- **ProductGantt**: Releases as bars (draggable), livrables as sub-rows. ReleaseBars, ProductLeftPanel, ProductSettingsPopup, ProductGanttTooltip.
- **Shared**: gantt/helpers.ts (parseDate, dateToPercent, getViewWindow, buildTickGroups, barColorForStatut), gantt/types.ts (layout constants), GanttLeftPanel, LivrableSubRows, GanttControls, Badge, MilestonesTrack

### Drag hooks
| Hook | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| useDragBarGeneric | Generic bar drag: move + resize-left + resize-right (3px threshold) |
| useDragPointGeneric | Generic point drag: move only (3px threshold) |
| useDragBar | Release bar drag wrapper |
| useDragPhaseBar | Phase bar drag wrapper |
| useDragMilestone | Milestone marker drag wrapper |
| useDragLivrable | Livrable icon drag wrapper |
| useGanttDragScroll | Horizontal scroll: mouse drag, touch swipe, Shift+wheel, animated nav |
